0022600026.text: Boston (5-2, 2nd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back) visits Charlotte (3-5, 9th in the East, 1.5 games back in the Southeast) with the Celtics on a one-game losing streak and the Hornets on a four-game skid. Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness) and Jayson Tatum (rest), and Charlotte is without Grant Williams (hamstring) and Kon Knueppel (leg soreness). The teams have not met yet this season, and Boston won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 113-102 victory in Boston on April 7, 2026.
